driver_scaling_120.random_ensemble_overhead_note: Across all 120 ER and Goh-Kahng-Kim Scale-Free realizations, every source SCC is a single zero-in-degree vertex, which is automatically unmatched in every maximum matching (alpha = beta), yielding (m + beta - alpha)/N = m/N.

cyclic_source_scc_overhead.description: 120-node networks with beta_c upstream zero-inflow 3-cycles feeding an intermediate ring and a 7-sink terminal bottleneck (m = 7 shared channels constant at 5.83%, while dedicated sites m + beta - alpha increase from 7 to 22; all PBH verified 120/120).
